item.text: The app uses Next’s App Router and the product “images” are colored blocks, so I’m using the browser’s View Transition API to morph each block by a product-specific name. I’ll coordinate that with router navigation, add forward and reverse slide styles, and give loaded Suspense content a short reveal animation. Reduced-motion users will get no motion effects, including the skeleton pulse.

item.text: I’ve wired the grid and detail image to the same per-product transition name, and the in-app links now carry forward/back direction into the route transition. I’m doing a final pass over event handling and the browser API call so the new navigation preserves normal link behavior where appropriate.

Implemented shared image and page transitions for the gallery. Product thumbnails and detail images use the same product-specific transition name, so the browser can morph them during navigation. Grid links slide forward, and the back link slides in reverse.

Loaded Suspense content gets a short reveal animation. When `prefers-reduced-motion` is enabled, route transitions, reveal animations, and skeleton pulses are disabled.

I didn’t run tests or a build.
